items.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work

items.lead_paragraph: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.

items.lead_paragraph: ChatGPT Images 2.5 helps turn your ideas, sketches, and reference photos into more personalized, polished images that better reflect your ideas.

items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.lead_paragraph: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

items.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
items.lead_paragraph: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.

items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.

items.lead_paragraph: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned. He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination.

items.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
items.lead_paragraph: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model.

items.lead_paragraph: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.

items.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
items.lead_paragraph: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.
